questions.prompt: Explain why line PT in the construction is tangent to circle O.
questions.prompt_markup: Explain why line PT in the construction is tangent to circle O.
questions.correct_answer: T is on the circle with diameter OP, so ∠OTP is inscribed in a semicircle and equals 90°; a line perpendicular to a radius at its endpoint on the circle is tangent.
questions.required_method: Use the circle on diameter OP and the tangent-radius theorem.
questions.grading_note: Any valid explanation. Essential: ∠OTP = 90° (inscribed angle on a diameter); PT ⊥ OT at T on circle O; converse of the tangent-radius theorem.
